room.name: A corner of the room in your head

balance.name: Somewhere your bank balance is safe

balance.request: Note: Leave no trace on the card statement.

urge.name: Beyond the reach of the urge to buy

urge.request: Note: Never give this address to the pay button.

door.name: The front door of your heart
door.date: Arrives: already here. Please accept it emotionally.
door.request: Note: Don't ring the bell. It drags you back to reality.

dream.name: Tonight's dream parcel locker

dream.request: Note: Slide it in quietly. It may vanish by morning.
